【文献标志码】A
Drug interaction study of ciprofol injection and rifampicin capsules
MA Yuanyuan1 , LU Lingqing1 , LING Yun1 , LIU Xiao2 (1 Shanghai Public Health clinical Center, Shanghai 201508, China; 2 Sichuan Haisco Pharmaceutical Group, Chengdu 611130, China)【ABSTRACT】 AIM To evaluate the potential influence of CYP enzyme on the metabolism of ciprofol injection by studying the drug-drug interaction (DDI) between cypofol injection and CYP2B6 enzyme strong inducer rifampin. METHODS The study was a single-center, open-label, randomized, two-stage, two-crossover clinical trial in healthy subjects. By comparing the pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD) and safety of cipofol injection, the DDI between cipofol and rifampicin was analyzed. RESULTS Compared with ciprofol injection along, steady-state rifampin showed no significant influence on the $\mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 - \infty } , \mathrm { A U C } _ { 0 - \mathrm { i n f } }$ and $C _ { \mathrm { m a x } }$ of ciprofol. The 90% confidence intervals of the geometric mean ratios of BIS $\mathrm { \sf A U C } _ { 0 - 1 }$ and $\mathrm { B I S } _ { \mathrm { p e a k } }$ were within the range from 80.00% to 125.00%. Steady-state rifampin had no significant effect on the efficacy (BIS value), safety and tolerability of cypofol. CONCLUSION The pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, safety and tolerability indexes of ciprofol are not affected by the CYP2B6 inducer rifampin.环泊酚（HSK3486）是四川海思科制药有限公司开发的全新的具有独立知识产权的静脉麻醉镇静药物，属于 γ- 氨基丁酸 A 受体（γ-aminobutyricacid subtype A receptor，GABAA）激动剂，作用机制与丙泊酚类似，其化学结构是在丙泊酚的结构基础上进行了手性结构改造，与 GABAA 受体的亲和力是丙泊酚的 4\~5 倍［1］。相关临床试验［2］数据表明环泊酚注射液具有起效快、效价高以及安全治疗窗较宽等优点，并且相较于丙泊酚发生呼吸抑制及心血管不良事件的概率较低，极具临床应用前景。
